rows.name: CCACHE_DISABLE

problems.statement: `bin/bsub-build` exports a non-empty value in the LSF build job.
problems.code_says: The script adds the export line only when its own environment holds a non-empty value, and it copies that value. With an unset or empty value the job gets no such variable. The job starts under `env -i`.

cells.What Tron does with it: When the submitting environment holds a non-empty value, `bin/bsub-build` exports the same value in the LSF build job. `bin/time_rebuild` exports `CCACHE_DISABLE=1` before its second, timed `make`. That build then runs without ccache (the compiler cache).

evidence: bin/bsub-build:54 - the loop over ENABLE_FUSE_STATS, CCACHE_DISABLE and XDG_CACHE_HOME
bin/bsub-build:55 - `if [ -n "${!var:-}" ]`: only a non-empty value is copied; line 56 adds `export <name>=<same value>` to the job command
bin/bsub-build:65 - the job starts with `env -i`, so no other value of the variable reaches it
bin/time_rebuild:17 - first `make`; line 18 `export CCACHE_DISABLE=1`; line 20 `time make`
README.md:510 - the variable travels when set in the submitting environment (line 504 at commit 7eddde7895)

rows.name: CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

problems.statement: If so, Tron passes no `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH` argument to `iwyu_external` (the include-what-you-use external project).
problems.code_says: The row leaves out the other case. When the variable is not defined, Tron passes a fixed LLVM directory under `/usr/lib` as `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH` to the sub-build. A developer outside the Nix dev shell whose LLVM is in another place needs this fact.
`flake.nix` is not a file of the configure step. It sets the variable for the Nix dev shells and the Nix CMake builds.

cells.Where: `cmake` configure step (`CMakeLists.txt`). `flake.nix` sets it in Nix dev shells and in the Nix CMake builds.
cells.What Tron does with it: The Tron configure step tests whether it is defined. If so, Tron passes no `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH` argument to `iwyu_external` (the include-what-you-use external project). That sub-build then inherits the variable. If not, Tron passes `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/lib/llvm-<version>`. `README.dependencies.md` gives the clang version.

unresolved: CCACHE_CONFIGPATH, CCACHE_DIR - whether the value of the preset `base-ninja` replaces a caller value in `cmake --preset <name>` and in `cmake --build --preset <name>`. The rows say only that the preset sets the path. The CMake manual cmake-presets(7) says that a preset sets each variable of its `environment` map also when the process environment already holds a value. No run was allowed here. One run of `CCACHE_DIR=/tmp/x cmake --build --preset native` followed by a look into `/tmp/x` settles it.

CXX - which program uses the value that the workflows `cmake-single-platform.yml` and `benchmark-golden.yml` set. No Tron file reads CXX there, and the CMake presets set `CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER` themselves. Candidates are the build tools of the dependencies, for example Meson and cargo build scripts. The configure and build log of one CI run with CXX removed settles it.

CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM - the sentence about CMake 4.x rests on the CMake documentation of this variable, not on Tron code. The repository holds only the assignment of `3.5`. The CMake manual page of `CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM` is the source.
notes: 12 rows of section 7.3 checked against commit 7eddde7895. No row contradicts the code. Unchanged (2): CCACHE_STATSLOG, CROSS_COMPILE. Changed for a fact (6): CCACHE_CONFIGPATH and CCACHE_DIR now state the value that `make`, the preset `base-ninja` and the Nix build set, and the Where cells name the Nix build. CCACHE_DISABLE states the condition of `bin/bsub-build` (the hint of the blind audit holds, bin/bsub-build:55). The text says 'submitting environment', as README.md does, since a `make CCACHE_DISABLE=1` command line also reaches the script. CCACHE_TEMPDIR and CCACHE_UMASK state that the export happens only when the Nix build uses ccache, as the CCACHE_STATSLOG row already does. CCACHE_TEMPDIR also gives the value. CCACHE_UMASK names the shared directory. CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH states the case in which the variable is not defined, and its Where cell separates the reader (`CMakeLists.txt`) from the setter (`flake.nix`). Changed for house rules only (4): CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CC, CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM, CXX. Rule 11: the five rows with 'Sets' in the Tron column started their Where cell with 'Nothing in Tron.'. They now start with 'No reader in Tron.'. Rule 5: CC lost '5 Nix dev shells' and 'The 2 Nix builds'. CXX lost '2 workflows' and 'Two workflows', and its Where cell names the two workflow files. CARGO_TARGET_DIR says 'A CI test' in place of 'One CI test'. Rule 8: CC no longer says 'clang 19'. CXX shows the workflow value as `/usr/bin/clang++-<version>`. CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH shows `/usr/lib/llvm-<version>`. The three rows point to `README.dependencies.md`, which records the clang version at README.dependencies.md:297. The code holds the literal number in all three places. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM: the value `3.5` is added. 'CMake 4.x' stays: it is the CMake generation in which the variable has an effect, not a pinned tool version. The CMake presets set a cache variable of the same name, which is not an environment variable, so the row does not list `CMakePresets.json`. CC and CXX named one Nix build in two ways. `cmake-sandbox-configure` is the check attribute (flake.nix:2231) and `tron-cmake-sandbox-configure` is the derivation name (flake.nix:1282). Both rows now use the derivation name, like `tron-cmake-test-build`. Tron column. The document treats such a use of a value that the same script just set as no read, for example in the CARGO_HOME row.
